premises.evidence_span: send to be incubated, hatched, and then killed 7 billion day-old male chicks

premises.evidence_span: scanning the egg through the eggshell in a non-invasive way pre-incubation at the speed of light

premises.text: A commercial sex-detectable breed of layers that lay sex-detectable eggs is under development
